ttl.description:
Time in seconds that the file should live (default {@link TmpFsConfig.ttlHours})
Please note that files **may remain longer than the configured TTL** based on when and how they are being cleaned-up or
deleted.

e.g If a CronJob is setup to clean files every 8 hours, then based on when the TTL expires and the next
clean-up is triggered, an TTL expired file (available-for-deletion) can stay up to 7 hrs 59 mins before getting
cleaned-up.

@see TmpFsConfig.ttlHours
@see TmpFileSystem.reapTmpFiles
